stages.purpose: select L* from independent no-model lexical baselines
compare fusion strategies with the same DEV-selected lexical leg
measure reranker contribution with candidate and fusion inputs held constant

selectionRules.lexicalLeg: quality, Hit@10/candidate-recall, p50 latency, resource cost, and operational complexity; eligible candidates must be within 0.02 of best Hit@10 and candidate recall, then highest MRR wins; differences below 0.02 MRR use lower latency/cost
selectionRules.parameters: select only from the frozen grids in v2.1-configurations.json on DEV
selectionRules.holdout: no tuning or winner changes; use selected configuration hashes unchanged
